name: MostWanted API
author: contact@xenastudios.co
description: The website's API and the Discord bot, one Java app (backend/ in the MostWanted repo). start.sh reads .env and runs backend.jar with a 256 MB heap. https://github.com/xena-studios/mostwanted

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Nothing to download: backend.jar and start.sh are uploaded, .env and tls/ written
# by hand (docs/12-launch.md, step 7).
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "MostWanted API: upload backend.jar and start.sh, then write .env and tls/."
